verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing pages explicitly mention native integrations with Slack (jira-intdir-1) and a marketplace of 3000+ apps including many common tools, plus Bitbucket/GitHub-adjacent dev tooling and Trello sync, but GitHub and Google Drive are never explicitly named as native integrations—only implied via generic '3rd party apps' and marketplace claims. Community evidence is silent on these specific integrations, so there's no independent corroboration of the exact tool list named in the story. missing for 10: explicit first-party or independent confirmation of native GitHub and Google Drive connectors, and hands-on validation of Slack/GitHub/Drive integration quality.
